outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and closes its gripper around the handle (frames 70–78, wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward, exposing its interior and yellow contents (frames 91–106, image and left_ego_image). It releases the handle and withdraws (frames 112–166); the drawer remains visibly open at frame 166 in image and left_ego_image. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
